description: Four stereo core frames with FixedBit set, LFF 3, PCMR 7 and SHUFF and BHUFF 7.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's decoder rejects the frames ('Reserved bit set': FixedBit), so ffprobe gets no sampling frequency or channels
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the set FixedBit, the first invalid field it reads (dca.c, ff_dca_parse_core_frame_header)
skip.libdca: libdca stops at the invalid tables.
